problem_statement: When the same multicast group is joined and then left by multiple independent subsystems, the membership report and leave report must reflect the actual reference count rather than any single join/leave. Joining an already-joined group must succeed (return 0) and must not emit another membership report; leaving a group that is still referenced by another subsystem must succeed without emitting a leave report, and the membership/leave reports must be emitted only on the very first join and the very last leave respectively (when the group is no longer referenced by anyone).
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/mld -s tests/net/mld/net.mld -s net.mld -O twister-out --no-clean -W
